anup bagchi.name: Anup Bagchi
anup bagchi.previous: MD & CEO, ICICI Prudential Life Insurance (Jun 2023 – Oct 2026)
career: Joined ICICI Group in 1992 — retail & corporate banking, treasury
anup bagchi.education: B.Tech IIT Kanpur; MBA IIM Bangalore
anup bagchi.succeeds: Sashidhar Jagdishan (CEO since Oct 2020; did not seek a third term)
anup bagchi.so_what: Outsider CEO — first HDFC Bank chief from a rival group. 34 years at ICICI across retail, broking and insurance; the bank also considered internal candidate Kaizad Bharucha.
